shortDescription: Copy a local file to a remote Comware v7 device

options.name: file
options.description: File (including absolute path of local file) that will be sent to the device

options.name: ftpdownload
options.description: If you want to download by FTP, change the params to true

options.name: ftpupload
options.description: If you want to upload by FTP, change the params to true

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the Comware v7 device that has NETCONF enabled

options.name: password
options.description: Password used to login to the switch

options.name: remote_path
options.description: Full file path on remote Comware v7 device, e.g. flash:/myfile. If no directory is included in remote_path, flash will be prepended. If remote_path is omitted, flash will be prepended to the source file name.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used to login to the switch
